ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black pixels with approximately 10-15% high-intensity white/light-gray pixels localized to the outer lobe tips and small scattered focal markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary solid black pigmentation across the central and lower fluke area. High-contrast white mottling and pixel clusters are concentrated at the distal tips. Scattered small-scale white circular and linear focal spots are present across the medial surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, obtuse U-shaped notch with moderate depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant pixel-amplitude variation with deep, jagged valleys and sharp peaks particularly prominent on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward sweep transitioning to convex lateral edges, terminating in tapered, slightly upward-curving tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Prominent cluster of high-contrast, raised white circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme right lobe tip. Minor circular scarring clusters present on the mid-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions scattered across the ventral surface, including a prominent vertical mark near the center-right and multiple horizontal scratches on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization causing structural protrusion on the right lobe tip. A distinct white ring-shaped mark is visible in the lower-central region of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A series of small, high-contrast white circular spots forming a loose vertical chain pattern on the right mid-lobe.
